about.title: About AxoriOS
about.lead: We built AxoriOS because a first sale shouldn't need a web developer.
about.body: Every seller we talked to had the same problem: the product was there, the customers were there, the store wasn't. So we built an agent that sets the store up, takes the payment and answers the questions, and leaves the seller to do the work only they can do.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subhead: Everything sellers ask before getting started. Still curious? Open an issue on the repo.

left.a: AxoriOS is an AI agent that takes a seller from a business idea to a first paid order. It drafts a brand, builds a storefront with PayPal checkout and sells for you on Telegram.
No. You describe your business by voice or text, in your own language, and approve what AxoriOS builds.
Not yet. This hackathon build runs on PayPal's sandbox, so the checkout flow is real but no real money moves.

left.q: How is AxoriOS different from a store builder?
left.a: A store builder gives you a theme to fill in. AxoriOS writes the store for you, takes the payment and keeps answering customers in chat.

right.q: Which tools does AxoriOS work with?
right.a: PayPal for checkout, Telegram for chat selling and Shopify for a one-way product and page sync. WhatsApp is built but switched off until it's tested.

right.q: What currency can I sell in?
right.a: Any ISO currency. If PayPal doesn't take it directly, AxoriOS converts to your settlement currency and shows the buyer both totals before they pay.

right.q: What if the agent gets something wrong?
right.a: It can't publish, schedule or connect anything without your approval, and it never sets a price or total. Those are always computed on the server.

right.q: How long until my store is live?
right.a: As long as it takes to describe your business and approve the preview. For most sellers that's one sitting.

security.logOutEverywhereBody: Ends every session on every device, including this one.
security.twoFactor: Two-factor sign-in and a list of active devices come later.

preferences.body: App language, Axori AI's reply language, voice input, theme and time zone. For now the app is in English and Axori AI replies in the language you write in.

notifications.body: Choose what to hear about, where, and quiet hours. For now new chats show in the bell and the Inbox.

ai.body: Choose what Axori AI may do on its own. You can make an action stricter, never looser: anything that publishes, sends, spends or connects always asks first.
ai.connectionTools: Actions that use a connection are set under Connections.

privacy.body: Export your data, set how long chats are kept, or delete your account. You can already export customers from Customers.

stores.body: Every business on this account. Use the store switcher at the top to change store or start a new business.
stores.archive: Archiving and deleting a store come later.

payments.paypalBody: Buyers pay through PayPal and the money stays in your PayPal account. This build uses PayPal's sandbox.
payments.settlement: Prices in {currency}; buyers are charged in {settlement}.
payments.pagaBody: Withdraw to a Nigerian bank through Paga. AxoriOS links out and records it in Money; it never holds your money.

messages.body: WhatsApp needs an approved template to message a customer more than 24 hours after their last message. These are the templates AxoriOS can send:
messages.editLater: Editing order and reminder wording and opt-out text comes later.

policies.body: Refund, privacy and terms pages for your storefront. For now ask Axori AI to add them to your store as sections.

activity.body: Every action Axori AI took and every approval, with who and when.
activity.empty: Nothing yet. Actions Axori AI takes for you show up here.

usage.body: Axori AI answers up to {cap} requests a day per store. The count resets at midnight UTC.
usage.images: Images and messages count against each provider's free tier.

team.body: Invite people to help run your stores, each with their own role.

connections.body: Everything your stores are connected to, what each can see, and what Axori AI may do with it.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.body: A one-way copy of your products, a collection and your pages.
shopify.data: Your products, prices and store pages. No customer data.
shopify.disconnectEffect: Syncing to {domain} stops. Products already copied stay in Shopify. You can connect again through Axori AI.

telegram.name: Telegram chat
telegram.body: Customers chat with your store's sales agent on Telegram.
telegram.data: Customers' Telegram names and the messages they send.
telegram.needsPublish: Publish your store to get a chat link.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp (Kapso)
whatsapp.body: Customers message your WhatsApp business number and replies go out through Kapso. A customer starts with "start {slug}".
whatsapp.bodyOff: Built and switched off until it's tested end to end with a real number.
whatsapp.data: Customers' phone numbers and the messages they send.

telegramChannel.name: Telegram channel
telegramChannel.body: Scheduled posts go to the store's Telegram channel.
telegramChannel.bodyOther: Only the demo store posts to the shared channel. Other stores get a download pack.

meta.name: Facebook & Instagram
meta.body: Demo connection: posts and numbers come from seed data until a Meta developer account is linked.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.body: Demo connection fed by seed data.

google.name: Google Business
google.body: Demo connection fed by seed data.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.body: Checkout on your storefront, chat payment links and refunds.
paypal.data: Buyers' names, emails, delivery addresses and payment status. Never card details.

paga.name: Paga
paga.body: Withdraw to a Nigerian bank. AxoriOS links out and records the withdrawal.
paga.data: Nothing; you record the amount and reference.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.body: Send orders to Google Sheets and other apps. Every write asks you first.
zapier.data: Only the order fields shown on each approval card.

customMcp.name: Custom MCP server
customMcp.body: Off. A custom server could read or change your data in ways AxoriOS can't check, so it isn't available in this build.

design.title: Design
design.subtitle: Brand kits, storefront templates and the media library shared by your stores.

media.uploadBody: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or PDF, up to 4 MB. Files are tagged by type and by the product they show; fix any tag by hand. Files dropped into Axori AI land here too.
media.notePlaceholder: e.g. red velvet slice for the weekend promo
media.uploadFailed: The upload didn't go through. Try again.
media.none: No files yet. Upload one here or drop it into Axori AI.
media.deleteBody: The file leaves the library for good. Files in use can’t be deleted.

brand.note: One brand kit per store. Axori AI writes it from how you describe the business; ask it to change any field.
brand.noLogo: No logo yet: the link preview shows a monogram.
brand.editPrompt: I want to change my brand kit for {name}.
brand.createPrompt: Help me create a brand kit for this store.

templates.note: Templates are layouts and spacing, never code. Each store stays on the version it has; a change to a template reaches a store only when you approve it.
templates.switch: Move a store with Axori AI
templates.switchPrompt: Switch my storefront to the {name} template.
